Subject: Renewal: MedAlign private environment + isolation nodes

Hi Aiden —

Quick follow on the upcoming renewal for your Private deployment (contract expires 2027-05-15). During our last call you mentioned adding an isolated analytics cluster and tightening tenant isolation for a new analytics partner. To recap the ask and proposed approach: 

- Add one dedicated analytics cluster (x2 DGX nodes equivalent) in the same VPC, with isolated subnets and strict egress rules.
- Expand KV-cache reservation and bump burst capacity by 30% during nightly batch window.
- Move to a 24-month term starting at renewal to lock pricing and capacity.

Deliverables attached: SOW_v3.pdf (scope + timelines) and pricing_summary.csv (line items).

Can we schedule a 30m call this week to confirm sizing and procurement path? If you prefer, I can loop in Karthik for a quick technical sizing sync before procurement engages.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tech sync (Karthik) — confirm node types & estimated op cost
2) Procurement readiness — sign amendment, PO timing
3) DocuSign for amendment + SOW

If these bullets look right I’ll kick off a formal amendment.

Thanks,
Neha

Subject: RE: Renewal: MedAlign private environment + isolation nodes — sizing notes

Hi all —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick technical sizing notes after reviewing current telemetry and the ask: 

- Recommended: +2 isolated serving clusters (3 nodes each) dedicated to analytics workload to provide headroom for peak read QPS of ~12k and sustained nightly batch writes.
- KV cache: reserve an additional 200GB for analytics prefixes; will reduce tail latency for repeated queries.
- Network: isolated subnets with egress-only NAT for the analytics cluster; make sure we add a CIDR block for partner access.
- Rollout: can apply as a blue/green within the same VPC to avoid downtime.

Preliminary cost delta estimate attached (pricing_summary.csv) — rough increase ~37% across hosting + reserved capacity line items. If you want a conservative cap, we can propose a burst reserve instead of permanent cluster addition to lower initial CAPEX.

I’m scheduled on Thu 14th 10:00am PT for the tech call (joined by Neha, Aiden, Monica). I’ll bring a short runbook for cutover and the KV cache sizing plan.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
